slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether an aircraft can carry only one bomb per trip or what the per-trip carrying capacity is. Its turn 9 catch-all question about additional constraints is too vague to count, and its later READY_TO_MODEL assumption of one bomb per run was not confirmed before stopping.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission objective to maximize the probability that at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is there a different optimization goal such as minimizing fuel used or maximizing the expected number of parts destroyed?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included the correct probability-maximization interpretation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each bombing run carries exactly one bomb, so the aircraft flies out with one bomb, drops it, and returns empty.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not receive confirmation of the one-bomb-per-trip constraint; it treated its own interpretation as a standard assumption in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved by the turn 1 question, but the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 one-bomb-per-trip carrying constraint remained unconfirmed.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective, but it failed to ask about the per-trip bomb carrying capacity and instead silently assumed one bomb per run in its final modeling summary. This leaves a material P1 hidden slot unresolved at stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
